name: Angband
tagline: Classic roguelike dungeon crawl to the depths of Angband
summary: Classic roguelike dungeon crawl to the depths of Angband
description: Angband 4.2.6 is a deep, turn based roguelike: roll a character from sixteen races and ten classes, descend a hundred levels of randomly generated dungeon, and kill Morgoth. This is the MayteraOS port (task #745 Tier 3 item 15), built as the GCU/ncurses frontend against the ported ncurses library and run inside the MayteraOS Terminal, which is a real VT220/xterm class emulator with antialiased TrueType glyphs and DEC special graphics mapped to Unicode. Includes the full lib data tree the game needs: gamedata, customize, help and screens. Saves, scores and panic files go to /GAMES/ANGBAND, a single shared location rather than a per-user one, for the reason recorded in the port recipe: the upstream per-user default resolves through getpwuid() and fails outright on an image where the first boot setup wizard has not run.
whatsnew: First release. Angband used to be baked into the golden image because its lib data lived at /ANGBAND, a top level directory the App Store installer refuses as a destination. The data now lives at /GAMES/ANGBAND/lib, so the game is served from here instead.
author: Angband Development Team (GPL-2.0-only)
license_note: Angband 4.2.6 is offered by upstream under either GPLv2 or the non-standard "Angband licence". MayteraOS redistributes under GPL-2.0-only, the clear and OSI-approved option. Option (b) was deliberately NOT chosen because it restricts use to educational, research and not-for-profit purposes, which GPL-2.0 does not. The port links userland/libc (MIT) and userland/ports/ncurses (X11-style permissive), neither copyleft.
